caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is predominantly brown with a glossy appearance and a slightly bulbous body narrowing toward the top. The handle, situated on the right, is ornate with curving decorative elements and is colored in brown tones matching the body of the pitcher. The spout extends gently to the left with a slight lip. The upper section of the pitcher is adorned with raised, swirling, vine-like patterns and a horizontal beaded border in a lighter, golden color. Below this, the main body of the pitcher features an embossed scene in gold depicting a steamship with two masts, cargo, rigging, and smokestacks emitting smoke. The base of the pitcher is slightly rounded and a darker brown, anchoring the vessel visually. The pitcher stands alone without any additional objects or decorations in the surrounding area.
title: Ewer - Fulton Steamboat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
